header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Dilawar Hussain advocate for the respondent No.1 a/w respondent
None present for the applicant nor any intimation is received. Same was
body: the position for last three dates of hearing, which shows that counsel for the applicant has lost interest in pursuing the matter. Therefore, this Court has no option but to dismiss the instant Criminal Misc. Application for non-prosecution. Accordingly, it stands dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE *Chander Kumar*
